Smugglers relabelled Nvidia's AI chips with a fake brand name, and shipped them to China!
Why go to all that trouble?
Because the best AI chips are banned in China, and demand there is huge.
In one case, at least a hundred and sixty million dollars' worth went through, declared as ordinary computer parts. The organiser pleaded guilty.
How did they get them out?
Through South-East Asia. Another case caught supercomputers packed with Nvidia chips on the way.
In March twenty twenty-six, a co-founder of Supermicro was arrested. Prosecutors allege two and a half billion dollars of servers, and dummy machines to fool inspectors.
One co-defendant has pleaded guilty. The co-founder has pleaded not guilty.
